thread:
marta: Heads-up: onboarding sample works in Node but crashes under Wranger/Wrangler-like edge env with 'Cannot use import statement outside a module'.

zach: which package?

marta: the js-sdk package. Repro: clone sample, npm i, wrangler dev -> error from dist/index.cjs.

samir: sounds like conditional exports falling back to CJS. Paste exports?

marta: exports block is simple: { \".\": { \"import\": \"./dist/index.mjs\", \"require\": \"./dist/index.cjs\", \"types\": \"./dist/index.d.ts\" }, \"./package.json\": \"./package.json\" }

elaine: Some workers/bundlers ignore import/require order. Wrangler seems to pick CJS even with type:module in sample.

zach: Options: 1) add a `worker` condition in exports, 2) publish an ESM-only edge package, or 3) provide a tiny CJS shim that proxies to ESM.

samir: Also auth providers: edge build pulled in a node-only provider that requires fs and caused init crash. We should separate providers into providers/node and providers/edge so tree-shaking keeps node code out of edge bundles.

marta: I reproduced the crash: it fails during auth init before any API call.

elaine: Short-term: add an index.cjs shim that `module.exports = require('./index.mjs').default` so existing resolvers don't break. Long-term: fix exports and types mapping, and add a `worker` condition.

zach: And add CI smoke tests running wrangler dev for the sample; block publish if smoke fails. Also include an edge-quickstart sample with explicit ESM import and wrangler.toml.

samir: I'll prototype the exports map with a `worker` condition and add types inside exports. If that looks stable we'll publish a patch.

marta: I'll add the smoke test and sample. ci-bot: queued test run for sample smoke.

elaine: Action items:
- samir: PR for conditional exports + types mapping (due Tue)
- marta: wrangler smoke test + edge sample (due Wed)
- elaine: release note & customer impact doc (due Thu)
- samir: temporary index.cjs shim to avoid breakage (today)

zach: If anyone hits it before we ship, ping me and I can flip a CDN redirect to prefer ESM.

marta: will post PRs here. :thumbsup:
summary: Thread about Edge runtime (Wrangler) resolving conditional exports to CJS; short-term shim and CI smoke tests, long-term: worker conditional, types in exports, split auth providers for edge vs node
